$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-02 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report c30f9aa4. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v26 index for sub2api (INDEX fda39db0) built by publish-tee-images run 33584380339 from commit c24e77f97; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin (INDEX cef1d03d) because deploy/attestor was not touched, and repinning it would widen the attested surface for nothing. VERIFICATION SCOPE, stated plainly: composeHash, osImageHash, the image digests and the build commit were each read back from a live source, and composeHash was cross-checked against two independent ones. The cosign keyless signature was NOT verified locally for this release - the workflow performs the signing and its run succeeded, and anyone can verify certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market plus the embedded githubWorkflowSha against the sourceCommit below, but this file does not claim it was done. This is by far the largest release in this line: it merges upstream through v0.1.185 and beyond, 964 files and roughly 96 thousand added lines, after eight versions without a sync. The reason for syncing now was Claude Fable 5.1, which landed on upstream main after the v0.1.185 tag, so the merge target was the branch rather than the tag. Fable 5.1 is served at 14 percent of official list pricing like every other model here; its own list price differs from Fable 5 only in cache reads, 0.25 rather than 1 dollar per million tokens, and that figure is in the hardcoded fallback table as insurance for the dynamic pricing feed. Three conflicts were resolved against our side rather than upstream's. The content security policy exists in three files and ours carries two directives upstream does not: wasm-unsafe-eval, without which the /proof page cannot compile the dcap-qvl WebAssembly module that verifies quotes in the browser, and media-src, without which the landing page video is blocked. A previous sync silently dropped both and they had to be restored afterwards, so this time the resolution asserted their presence and would have failed loudly. Upstream's new frame-src self was merged in alongside them. HomeView.vue was taken wholly from our side because it is a complete replacement rather than a modification. The audit exception list rejected three revived entries whose advisories no longer match the installed versions, while accepting a new one. Two defects surfaced that only a merge can produce. The abuse detector's provider had never been registered in any wire provider set - it existed solely as a hand-written line inside the generated file, which meant code generation could not be run at all and every sync required hand-merging generated output. It is registered now and the file is generated. Separately, ent's runtime indexes schema fields by position, so a textual merge paired upstream's indices with our wider Group schema: it compiled and then panicked at init with an interface conversion error. Regeneration fixed it. Neither is the kind of thing a compiler catches. Sixteen migrations were added, all new files, none of the already-applied ones touched. They were rehearsed against a restored copy of the production database before this deploy: 276 recorded migrations became 292 with no errors, and the merged binary was then booted against that same data and served health checks, which is also what would have caught the ent panic. Tests: 58 backend packages, the repository integration suite, go vet clean; 272 frontend files and 1989 cases, type check and lint clean. Earlier in this line: proof-v24 (public pricing copy aligned to 14 percent and a 50 percent revenue share), v23 (alert minimum sample size, SLA error definition), v22 (attach-time probe), v21 (supplier self-service re-authorization), v20, v19, v18, v17, v16/v15. proof-v25 was built from the same tree one commit earlier and skipped, so that the commit recorded below is exactly the branch tip. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation, and the control plane confirms is_dev false after the rollout. A full postgres backup was taken and verified beforehand - downloaded from S3, gzip-tested, 108 COPY sections. This rollout completed in 84 seconds with no incident.
